'''Onya Oruel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] along with her [[Onya Oruel's sister|sister]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] she was kidnapped by the [[Twin Suns (pirates)|Twin Suns]] slavers on her sister's [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farm]] and taken to [[Anchorhead Spaceport]] along with other prisoners. The prisoners were held there for a week, however before they could be transferred off-world, a spacer hired by [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] [[Sheriff/Legends|sheriff]] [[Encot]] stormed the hangar 21, where the prisoners were held in, and killed the pirates, allowing the captives to escape.<ref name="SWTOR" /> Onya Oruel later wrote a letter of thanks to her rescuer.<ref name="mail" />

==Behind the scenes==
Onya Oruel appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as one of the unnamed prisoners during the mission "Smuggler's Route" on Tatooine. She is later identified by name in the letter she sends and although the letter does not specify her species, all prisoners freed during the mission are Human females.
